three_party_exchanges.scenario: Entity A gives asset to Entity B, Entity B gives asset to Entity C, Entity C gives asset to Entity A
three_party_exchanges.accounting: Each entity evaluates commercial substance separately. Record based on FV of asset given up or received.
three_party_exchanges.example: A exchanges land (BV $100K, FV $150K) with B for equipment (FV $150K). Commercial substance exists. A: DR Equipment $150K, DR Acc Depr (land N/A), CR Land $100K, CR Gain $50K.

multiple_asset_exchanges.scenario: Exchange multiple assets for multiple assets
multiple_asset_exchanges.approach: Analyze as portfolio. Determine aggregate FV given and received. Calculate single gain/loss.
multiple_asset_exchanges.commercial_substance: Evaluate based on overall transaction (do future cash flows change significantly?)

boot_in_complex_transactions.general_rule: Boot (cash) given or received affects valuation
boot_in_complex_transactions.boot_payer: Asset received = FV of assets given + Cash paid (if commercial substance)
boot_in_complex_transactions.boot_receiver: Asset received = FV of assets given - Cash received. May recognize partial gain if no commercial substance.

involuntary_conversions.definition: Asset destroyed, condemned, or stolen. Receive insurance or government proceeds.
involuntary_conversions.accounting: Similar to nonmonetary exchange. Gain/Loss = Proceeds - BV of asset given up.
involuntary_conversions.example: Building (BV $500K) destroyed by fire. Insurance pays $600K. Gain = $600K - $500K = $100K. DR Cash $600K, CR Building $500K, CR Gain $100K.

exchange_for_equity_interest.contribution_to_entity: Contributing asset to partnership/corporation in exchange for equity
exchange_for_equity_interest.general_rule: Recognize at FV of asset contributed (may recognize gain/loss)
exchange_for_equity_interest.exception: If control established (>50% ownership), may not recognize gain (ASC 845)

productive_use_exchanges.similar_assets: Assets similar in nature and use (truck for truck, machinery for machinery)
productive_use_exchanges.if_no_commercial_substance: Defer gain (use book value). Loss recognized immediately.

calculation_example_three_party.facts: Company exchanges equipment (BV $80K, FV $100K) for land (FV $100K). Commercial substance.
calculation_example_three_party.entry: DR Land $100K, DR Acc Depr $40K (assuming equipment had $120K cost, $40K acc depr to reach $80K BV), CR Equipment $120K, CR Gain $20K

calculation_example_multiple_assets.facts: Exchange: Equipment (BV $100K, FV $120K) + Vehicle (BV $30K, FV $40K) for Building (FV $160K). Commercial substance.
calculation_example_multiple_assets.analysis: Total FV given = $120K + $40K = $160K. Total BV given = $100K + $30K = $130K. Gain = $160K - $130K = $30K.
calculation_example_multiple_assets.entry: DR Building $160K, DR Acc Depr (equipment), DR Acc Depr (vehicle), CR Equipment, CR Vehicle, CR Gain $30K

tax_considerations.like_kind_exchanges: Tax code (IRC 1031) allows deferral for like-kind exchanges. GAAP and tax treatment may differ.
tax_considerations.book_tax_difference: If gain deferred for tax but recognized for GAAP (or vice versa), creates temporary difference (deferred tax)

advertising_barter.definition: Exchange advertising services/space with another company
advertising_barter.gaap_rule: Recognize at FV only if: (1) FV more reliably measurable than BV, AND (2) transaction has commercial substance
advertising_barter.often_not_recognized: Many advertising barters fail test (lack commercial substance or reliable FV)

cpa_exam_tips: Three-party: Each entity evaluates separately. Record at FV if commercial substance.
Multiple assets: Aggregate FV given and received, calculate single gain/loss.
Boot payer: Asset received = FV given + Cash paid (if commercial substance)
Boot receiver: May recognize partial gain if no commercial substance
Involuntary conversion: Insurance proceeds - BV = Gain/Loss
Advertising barter: Recognize at FV only if reliably measurable AND commercial substance

key_points: Three-party exchanges: Each entity evaluates separately for commercial substance
Multiple assets: Aggregate FV and BV to calculate single gain/loss
Boot: Payer adds cash to FV given. Receiver subtracts cash from FV given.
Advertising barter: Recognize at FV only if measurable AND commercial substance
